title: Team
lead: The people who hold a role on your realms, cities and administrative bodies.
leadCity: The people who hold a role in {city}.
empty: Nobody holds a role here yet.
emptyHint: Invite a colleague by email. They get the role at their first sign-in.
invitationsHint: An invite stays open for {days} days. After that it expires, and a resend opens it again.
historyEmpty: No role was revoked and no invite was withdrawn here.

roleHint.admin: Everything below, and the team: invites and revokes roles.
roleHint.records: Edits the records: transcripts, subjects, minutes. Exports them.
roleHint.meetings: Manages the meetings: adds, releases, runs the processing tasks.
roleHint.highlights: Manages the highlights and sends the notifications.
roleHint.viewer: Reads the unreleased records and exports the transcripts.

revoke.title: Revoke role
revoke.description: The account keeps every other role it holds. The row moves to the history.
revoke.failed: The role could not be revoked.

withdraw.title: Withdraw invite
withdraw.description: The invite link stops working. The row moves to the history.
withdraw.failed: The invite could not be withdrawn.

resend.failed: The invite could not be sent again.

dialog.title: Invite to the team
dialog.description: A new address gets an invite email, and the role takes effect at the first sign-in. An account that signed in before gets the role at once, and an email that says so.
dialog.name: Name (optional)
dialog.emailFailed: The role was given, but the invite email could not be sent. Ask the person to sign in with their email.

errors.last-admin: This is the last admin of the scope. Only an admin of the scope above can revoke it.
errors.cap: The scope has reached its limit of roles.
errors.machine-address: This address is reserved for machine accounts.
errors.claimed: The person claimed this role. Only a superadmin can remove it, on the users page.
errors.duplicate: The account already holds this role on this scope.
